model_pose_and_expression.name: model_pose_and_expression
values: Head-on frontal pose: Subject faces the camera directly with body squared or slightly turned, hands relaxed by the side, featuring a serene and composed expression.
Three-quarter candid turn: Body turned to a 3/4 angle while the head turns back toward the lens; eyes glance slightly past the camera as one hand gently rests near the jawline.
Dynamic motion pose: Captured mid-step with hair blowing gently in the breeze; one hand adjusts the flowing edge of her saree pallu while delivering a genuine, broad smile.
Joyful tilt pose: Body angled at 3/4 with head tilted slightly back as if caught in mid-laughter; eyes crinkled with hands rising instinctively toward her chest.
Pensive seated pose: Seated against a stone pillar or ledge, leaning forward slightly with hands folded gracefully on her lap and an contemplative gaze.
Over-the-shoulder glance: Walking away from the camera and glancing back over her shoulder, framing the intricate details of the back blouse and pallu drape.
